one_rail_at_a_time_overlap_mA.note: Jack loads and magnitude LEDs return to ground and draw from one analog rail at a time; this lowers total power only. Per-rail current is unchanged because all outputs may sit at one polarity together.

double_counting_and_margins.iq_spread_note: Planning mixes guaranteed full-temperature maxima (TI OPA419x) with unverified planning allowances (ADG5412 extrapolated to +/-12 V, HC logic, NOISE2, LM13700) that could be exceeded. The sum of ~260 packages is unlikely to sit at every maximum, but no distribution is retained, so no statistical credit is taken without measurement.
double_counting_and_margins.lm393_minus12: Stage54 clip_comparator_accounting confirms pin 4 on -12V for every LM393 row that charges -12 V (A01-A06, M4A/B, M5A/B), despite a row basis saying no -12 V current; planning stays, typical gains 10 mA. H/O/E LM393 rows book 0 mA on -12 V (possible under-booking, open).
double_counting_and_margins.ota_bias_overlap_with_reserves: OPEN: reserve rows state a conservative overlap with the inherited OTA bias allowance (26 IABC branches); size unknown, no credit taken.
double_counting_and_margins.stage54_note: Unadopted conditional removal of idle op-amp quads; listed separately, not applied to any level.

normal_typical.classification: CALCULATED from reported/assumed typical rows; UNVERIFIED
normal_typical.basis: Every row at its reported/assumed typical, plus the Stage54 clip-comparator -12 V typical correction; allowances at pre-sensitivity draft values (protection/supervision and reference/logic included, unlike the ledger reported typical subtotal).

heavy_realistic_patch.classification: CALCULATED planning upper with documented impossible combinations removed; UNVERIFIED
heavy_realistic_patch.basis: Canonical planning (full-temperature maximum Iq, every output into 10 kohm at 5 V, every indicator at planning brightness, all reserves) minus only the per-rail charges whose own worksheet basis says cannot occur. Every output may hold a positive DC CV at once, so per-rail signal loads are not halved.

canonical_planning_all_upper_terms.classification: PLANNING ALLOCATION (canonical; governs the current requirement)

explicit_usage_limit_candidate.classification: CANDIDATE operating range (PWR-D5); CALCULATED, UNVERIFIED; not a requirement
explicit_usage_limit_candidate.basis: Fixed parts and internal signal paths at planning; external patch/indicator and operation rows held to their typical values by a stated usage limit (for example: indicators near typical brightness, outputs into typical 100 kohm loads). Shows the most any patch-based usage limit can remove; enforcement is by user instruction only.

startup_worst_envelope.basis: Canonical planning plus the full-capacitance ramp at the 10 ms minimum soft start (capacitance ceiling +20 %). Loads draw less at reduced voltage, so this overstates a real ramp; the 20 ms transient requirement covers it with the one-fault increment.

startup_envelope_fitted_capacitance.classification: CALCULATED from OSC-owner-reported fitted capacitance; UNVERIFIED; not a contract value
startup_envelope_fitted_capacitance.basis: Canonical planning plus the ramp of the fitted 49.9 / 42.2 / 24.5 uF (+20 %) at the 10 ms minimum soft start. The contract keeps the 150 / 150 / 100 uF ceiling and the transient requirement unchanged; a later capacitance addition up to the ceiling stays allowed.

transient_requirement_20ms.basis: canonical + ramp + one external-forcing fault, rounded; supply-architecture.json

continuous_requirement.basis: canonical x 1.1, rounded up to 100 mA

sixty_watt_class_screen.status: Rail output power only. Charger input power = rail output / end-to-end efficiency (converters, LDO headroom, cable, PDO). No efficiency is booked here; the PD owner screens the supply side.
sixty_watt_class_screen.current_ldo_chain_note: From ledger.json: pre-rail power with the existing LDO post-regulation (PD-screened minimum pre-rail setpoints). Converter efficiency is not booked; PD screened about 0.85 at its own 1.2/0.8/0.5 A targets.
